name: GPU Helper
description: Experimental iOS Metal/OpenGL ES hybrid-rendering research with an opt-in shared-texture interop probe, Metal visibility measurements, and persistent diagnostics.

debug-overlay.name: Show in-game GPU diagnostics overlay
debug-overlay.description: Show the large live diagnostic HUD with a 4 Hz changing update counter, per-level scan breakdown, driver heartbeats, Metal submit/completion counts, visibility results, GPU timing, and persistent crash-trace status.

metal-opengl-interop-probe.name: Experimental Metal / OpenGL ES shared-texture probe
metal-opengl-interop-probe.description: Opt-in test created during the active Cocos OpenGL ES draw callback. Creates a Core Video pixel buffer with Metal and OpenGL ES texture views. Validates shared texture creation only; it does not draw into the game or change rendering.

gpu-decoration-culling.name: GPU static-decoration visibility measurement (safe mode)
gpu-decoration-culling.description: Use Metal to measure ungrouped static decoration bounds against the camera. SAFE MODE ONLY: results are diagnostic and are not applied to rendering. No GameObject::visit override or render skipping is installed. This build prioritizes crash isolation and persistent diagnostics over FPS gains.
